archetypes.name: dyn-publish-lifecycle
archetypes.rationale: Design publish paths now share centralized log-publish and tracking-summary gating.
archetypes.prompt_body: Inspect the changed /design terminal, clarify, and step5c publish paths for double-publish regressions or missed failure gates. Pay close attention to outcomes that already published logs versus outcomes routed through centralized log-publish. Verify RECOVERY_BRANCH and PUBLISH_OK parsing consistently prevent stale tracking comments and completion sentinels. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
